changelog:
Auto-Research v0.1.0 — initial release!

- Allows autonomous research on any topic via both natural language and command-line triggers
- Outputs structured briefings with summaries, key findings, and full source tracking into your Obsidian vault
- Stores research as semantically searchable vectors in Qdrant
- Includes source quality assessment and smart caching (Redis/local) for search results
- Fully documented setup and usage, with example outputs and troubleshooting tips
